verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents scoped API keys with granular Read/Write permissions per resource (not full account access), and explicitly ties this to agent use cases via AgentOS/MCP with additional layered safety defaults (no money-out actions by default, OAuth-scoped roles, role-gated CLI authorization). This directly matches the story of issuing least-privilege credentials for an agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of scope enforcement and no documented UI/API walkthrough of creating a scoped key specifically for an agent identity.
